/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from collections import Counter
root=Path('/tmp/spring-reconciliation.gX3L7L')
pages=json.loads((root/'pages.json').read_text())
customers=json.loads((root/'customers.json').read_text())
result=json.loads(Path('/workspace/result.json').read_text())
assert [p['page'] for p in pages] == list(range(1,pages[0]['total_pages']+1))
assert all(p['next']==f'/orders?page={p[\"page\"]+1}' for p in pages[:-1])
assert pages[-1]['next'] is None
listings=[o for p in pages for o in p['items']]
counts=Counter(o['id'] for o in listings)
unique={o['id']:o for o in listings}
totals=dict.fromkeys(('north','south','east','west'),0)
count=0
for o in unique.values():
 t=datetime.fromisoformat(o['placed_at'].replace('Z','+00:00')).astimezone(timezone.utc)
 if o['status']=='shipped' and '2025-03-01' <= t.date().isoformat() <= '2025-05-31':
  c=customers[o['customer_id']]
  net=Decimal(o['amount_cents'])*(Decimal(1)-Decimal(c['discount_pct'])/Decimal(100))
  totals[c['region']]+=int(net.quantize(Decimal(1),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
  count+=1
expected={'total_cents':sum(totals.values()),'order_count':count,'duplicates_skipped':sum(v-1 for v in counts.values()),'by_region':totals}
assert result==expected
assert list(result)==['total_cents','order_count','duplicates_skipped','by_region']
assert all(type(v) is int for v in totals.values())
print('Independent recomputation passed:', json.dumps(expected))
print('Listings:',len(listings),'Unique orders:',len(unique))
PY"
